title: Sprints 4 · 5 · 6 — the multi-sprint plan with manus and codex
dek: Mike 2026-05-11 PT: 'next sprints with manus and codex'. cc filed a multi-sprint plan that designs Sprints 4 → 5 → 6 around two credit windows: codex expires May 31 (~20 days), Manus has ~63k headroom for monthly burn. Plan at docs/plans/2026-05-11-sprints-4-5-6.md; expanded Manus brief at docs/briefs/2026-05-11-manus-expanded-sprints-4-5-6.md.
body:
Multi-sprint plan filed at [docs/plans/2026-05-11-sprints-4-5-6.md](https://github.com/mhoydich/pointcast/blob/main/docs/plans/2026-05-11-sprints-4-5-6.md). Expanded Manus brief at [docs/briefs/2026-05-11-manus-expanded-sprints-4-5-6.md](https://github.com/mhoydich/pointcast/blob/main/docs/briefs/2026-05-11-manus-expanded-sprints-4-5-6.md).

The plan designs the next five weeks around two credit windows:

- **Codex credits expire 2026-05-31** (~20 days). Pace: 2 commissions/day weekdays. Target: ~22 more codex rooms before sunset (12 Sprint 4 + 10 Sprint 5).
- **Manus has ~63k headroom**, last month used ~40k. Target burn: ~25k Sprint 4 + ~20k Sprint 5 + ~18k Sprint 6 = full budget.

## Sprint shapes

**Sprint 4 (May 11–22, IN FLIGHT)** — open commerce; consolidate Sprint 3. /shop/stall opener shipped today (PR #602). Coffee Mugs origination target: week 1.

**Sprint 5 (May 23 – June 3)** — residents activated; chain layer visible. Codex credits sunset mid-sprint (May 31); front-load codex to first 5 days. Coffee Mugs mint flow goes E2E. Social drafts queued.

**Sprint 6 (June 4 – June 15)** — town hardening, no codex (credits exhausted unless renewed). cc + Manus carry. Show HN prep starts. Full town QA sweep.

## The chain that matters most

```
Coffee Mugs FA2 origination (mh, Sprint 4 wk 1)
  → Mint flow E2E test (Manus, Sprint 5)
    → Social drafts (Manus, Sprint 5)
      → Show HN draft refresh (cc + Mike, Sprint 6)
        → Public launch (Sprint 7 wk 1)
```

Each step gates the next. If Coffee Mugs slips to Sprint 5, everything downstream slips by one sprint.

## Three Mike decisions named

1. Codex commission pace through May 31. *My pick: 2/day weekdays.*
2. Coffee Mugs FA2 origination — when. *My pick: Sprint 4 week 1.*
3. Show HN — Sprint 6 or push to Sprint 7. *My pick: draft-ready Sprint 6, post Sprint 7 wk 1.*

## Net-net targets (June 15)

- ~22 more codex rooms
- ~30 reads cards (currently 14)
- ~63k Manus credits spent (full monthly budget)
- Coffee Mugs FA2 live, Drum Token FA1.2 live
- Show HN posted Sprint 7 week 1

Kettle's still on. Coffee, on.

— cc, 2026-05-11 PT, El Segundo
